name: Conduit of Worlds
clause: {T}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'cast-card'; from: 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'hand'; target?: TargetSpec; filter?: Filter; mvLE?: Amount; optional?: true } - cast a chosen or targeted card from that zone, PAYING its costs
needs.semantics: The acting player casts the named card during this resolution; the spell goes on the stack above the ability and its costs are paid normally (an unpayable cost means the cast does not happen). Complements cost-alter's free cast-free and the standing cast-from permission.
needs.clause: If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card.

needs.proposedSignature: condition { kind: 'spells-cast-this-turn-le'; who: 'you' | 'that-player'; value: number } and effect { op: 'cant-cast'; who: 'you' | 'each-opponent' | 'target-player'; filter?: Filter; duration: 'this-turn' }
needs.semantics: The condition mirrors the existing spells-cast-this-turn-ge and answers 'if you haven't cast a spell this turn' (value 0). The effect installs a one-shot casting restriction for the rest of the turn over spells matching filter.
needs.clause: If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. / Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn.

needs.proposedSignature: static { kind: 'play-from-zone'; zone: 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'library-top'; filter?: Filter; oncePerTurn?: boolean; grants?: Ability } and effect { op: 'cast-from-zone'; target: TargetSpec; zone: SetZone; free?: boolean }
needs.semantics: A permission to play/cast cards from another zone, optionally limited to once per turn and optionally granting the object an ability while it is played this way; plus the one-shot 'you may cast that card' form an activated ability uses.
needs.clause: 'Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell ...' / 'you may cast that card'
